items.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I was always being influenced by Johnny Hodges

ctx.x: Were there certain artists at the time on record that you were being influenced by?

Oh yeah. As a matter of fact I was always being influenced by Johnny Hodges and Benny Carter and Willie Smith that played lead with Jimmy Lunceford’s band and later on he played with the Harry James band.
